🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech, Energy, Materials positive while Financials, Healthcare, Industrials negative) and leadership concentrated in semiconductors/materials/healthcare (Top 5 span 3 sectors), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND. Energy/Materials follow: SLB (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weak: JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Industrials show material weakness: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (Top 5 span Technology, Materials, Healthcare) — not narrowly concentrated but not broad.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -13.05% | 1M: +7.17%) CORRECTION, RTX (1W: -11.28% | 1M: -10.64%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-beta Industrials/Materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence present (multiple large caps in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND), so momentum is tactical rather than uniform.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on semiconductors and select software names: AAPL (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +14.44%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND; Tech: ~14/24 positive — Internal Rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed/soft 1W: JPM (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.29% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION — Financial sector showing internal rotation with upside in 1M but short-term weakness; Financials: ~8/20 positive — Internal Rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure: UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare: ~4/17 positive — Sector Weakness.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective semiconductors and names showing confirmed 1W+1M strength (AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND for sector leadership; reduce exposure to broken Industrials/Comm names (CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND — downside risk remains.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (Tech: ~14/24 positive) and Energy (Energy: ~7/10 positive) on 1W strength. BEARISH: Healthcare (Healthcare: ~4/17 positive) and Communication (Communication: ~2/10 positive) where weakness is concentrated.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND — watch for sustained weekly momentum and volume to confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND — monitor 1M trend support for re-entry signals. INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/outlook follow-through is the trigger for further upside. UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND — watch guidance linger for further sector rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+85): Adobe’s AI monetization and buyback news; price confirming with recent strength in software names (ADBE not in top lists but news confirms potential). INTC (+75): Intel Q1 beat; price confirming — INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND. UNH (+80): Q1 beat and guidance hike; UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (-55): Weak obesity pill data; LLY (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. FCX (-50): Downgrade headline; FCX (1W: -13.05% | 1M: +7.17%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with short-term pullback. ADBE (-50): Contrarian negative headlines vs +85 item — sentiment divergence to monitor (news mix is creating distribution risk).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple CORRECTION signals and mixed news sentiment on ADBE/LLY/FCX) — monitor for trend confirmation before increasing exposure.
